verdict.line: You out-trade Malphite before level 6-7 off Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks and E (Footwork) disengages, but the 44.9% head-to-head over 49 games says his armor-scaling W/E kit claws the lane back mid-game unless you rush your MR tank items.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's Q (Ntofo Strikes) fires every 3.5s and out-paces how fast Malphite's Granite Shield can recharge, which is why the data marks K'Sante with the lane and solo-kill edge early. The problem is Malphite's W (Brutal Strikes) hands him a temporary armor/AD spike and his E (Ground Slam) deals magic damage scaled off that same armor stat, so once he itemizes defensively his trades start out-value K'Sante's — which is the structural reason the raw 49-game win rate sits below the matchup's early read.

theirWindow.when: His shield is up, W active
theirWindow.what: Granite Shield is absorbing your burst and Brutal Strikes is buffing his armor and AD on top of it, so standing in extended auto trades loses value here — disengage with E (Footwork) and wait rather than force it.

yourWindow.when: Right after he last took damage
yourWindow.what: Granite Shield only recharges once Malphite hasn't been hit recently, so chain Q (Ntofo Strikes) to keep it broken, and once you're at 2 Q stacks the shockwave pulls him in — that's your window to commit the all-in.

powerCurve.note: Both melee, Granite Shield still absorbs first pokes
Q stacks + E shield-dash win extended trades

start.why: Both Seismic Shard (Q) and Ground Slam (E) are magic damage, so the magic resist and ability-hit sustain on Helm keeps your HP bar higher through his poke than Doran's Shield does — matches the dominant 85.1% pick and its better 45.6% win rate.

boots.why: Seismic Shard (Q) steals your movement speed on hit, and Mercs' tenacity cuts that slow short while the magic resist blunts his magic-damage poke pattern overall.

core.why: The spellblade proc adds burst to your Q/E trade pattern while you're still winning exchanges levels 3-6.
The spell-shield eats a full Seismic Shard or Ground Slam burst, which is exactly when Malphite tries to flip a losing trade.
Stacking magic resist and health directly answers his Ground Slam scaling off his own armor stat, which is the mechanic that erodes your lane lead late.

situational.when: the enemy team adds heavy physical damage or crit alongside Malphite
you need the heal-on-damage sustain to keep winning extended mid-game poke wars
you want the healing amplification to outlast his magic damage over a longer fight

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs on your Q/auto trades, healing and growing bonus health through every short Q (Ntofo Strikes) exchange — exactly the sustain you need before his Brutal Strikes window opens.

summoners.why: The 82.4% pick rate reflects a scaling matchup you're favored to win early — Teleport lets you reset waves and come back with full HP/mana after trading, rather than surrendering tempo to hold the lane solo.

playing.title: Trade right after his shield breaks
playing.detail: Granite Shield only regenerates if Malphite hasn't taken damage recently — chain Q (Ntofo Strikes) hits so it never resets, then commit harder once it's down.

playing.title: Hold Q for the 2-stack pull
playing.detail: At 2 Ntofo Strikes stacks your next Q fires a shockwave that pulls him in — line this up around level 3+ for a solo-kill attempt rather than spending stacks one at a time.

playing.title: Save E for his Q poke, not your engage
playing.detail: Footwork's dash and shield are better spent dodging or soaking Seismic Shard's damage/slow than opening trades — he has no way to punish you for holding it.

playing.title: Back off during his Brutal Strikes window
playing.detail: Once he activates W, his armor and AD spike for a short duration — disengage with E rather than standing in extended autos until it drops.

playing.title: Engage W around his Ground Slam cooldown
playing.detail: Ground Slam (7s cooldown) cuts your attack speed if you're caught in it — time your Path Maker (W) stun engage for when it's down so your follow-up autos actually land at full speed.

playing.title: Rush MR tank items once trades even out
playing.detail: Once Brutal Strikes and Ground Slam come online around levels 7-11, prioritize Kaenic Rookern and Jak'Sho over pure damage — his kit's late scaling is magic damage off his own armor, and that's what the 44.9% head-to-head is losing to.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from live K'Sante vs Malphite games on the current patch; the trade timings, cooldown reads, and power-curve verdict are my own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.
